SELECT goods_brand.id, goods_brand.name, goods_brand.logo_url, COUNT(goods_spu.id) AS goods_count FROM goods_brand AS goods_brand INNER JOIN goods_spu AS goods_spu ON goods_spu.brand_id = goods_brand.id LEFT JOIN goods_category AS goods_category ON goods_spu.category_second_id = goods_category.id
AND goods_brand.`del_flag` = '0' AND goods_brand.`status` = '0' AND goods_spu.`del_flag` = '0' AND goods_spu.`status` = '1' AND goods_category.`del_flag` = '0'
AND LOWER(goods_spu.`name`) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query.name}),'%')
AND goods_spu.`category_first_id` = #{query.categoryFirstId}
AND goods_spu.`category_second_id` = #{query.categorySecondId}
GROUP BY goods_brand.id, goods_brand.name, goods_brand.logo_url, goods_brand.sort
ORDER BY goods_brand.sort ASC, goods_count DESC, goods_brand.id ASC
